children: ServisFirst Bancshares said its board has approved an inaugural stock repurchase plan for up to 2 million shares.

The new repurchase authorization runs through Dec. 31, 2027, the holding company for ServisFirst Bank said. ServisFirst Bank serves customers from locations in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North and South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Virginia.
The company has a market capitalization of $4.21 billion, 109.3 million shares outstanding, and a public float of 102.1 million shares.
Shares closed the day's regular trading session at $38.07, down 1.3%.
